summary: Crash when zombie tries to spawn second reinforcement
description: Summary The game crashes when a zombie tries to spawn a zombie reinforcement for the second time. (Relates to MC-272321) Steps to Reproduce - Set Difficulty to Hard. - Either: Spawn a leader Zombie. (A zombie have 5 chance of being a leader zombie, which is capable of summoning reinforcements.) Or, spawn a zombie and run the following command to make it a leader: /attribute @e[type=zombie,limit=1] minecraft:zombie.spawn_reinforcements base set 1 - Switch gamemode to Survival. - Attack the zombie using snowballs. (Other projectiles can also be used.) - One reinforcement zombie spawns. - Continue hitting the original zombie with snowballs. Expected Result Game does not crash. Actual Result Game crashes.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Set the game difficulty to Hard.
2. Spawn a zombie or run the command `/attribute @e[type=zombie,limit=1] minecraft:zombie.spawn_reinforcements base set 1` to make an existing zombie a leader.
3. Switch your gamemode to Survival.
4. Attack the zombie using snowballs until one reinforcement zombie spawns.
5. Continue hitting the original zombie with snowballs.
6. Observe that the game crashes when attempting to spawn a second reinforcement zombie.
Observed Behavior:
### Actual Result

When the second reinforcement zombie is attempted to be spawned by the leader zombie after initial attack, the game crashes without any further warning or error messages. This issue occurs consistently under the conditions specified in the steps to reproduce. No visual cues or debug information are provided before the crash happens.
Expected Behavior: When following the reproduction steps, the game should not crash when a leader zombie attempts to spawn its second reinforcement zombie. The original zombie should continue to summon additional zombie reinforcements without any stability issues, ensuring smooth gameplay in Survival mode on Hard difficulty.
